# wirral.ai

> AI consultancy for UK organisations. We help businesses decide where AI
> genuinely fits, implement the solutions that follow, automate work where the
> volume warrants it, and build the internal capability to use AI responsibly.

Based in Widnes, in the North West of England, working on site across Wirral,
Liverpool, Manchester, Chester, Warrington and North Wales, and with
organisations UK-wide. More than forty organisations supported.

## Positioning

wirral.ai is not an AI automation agency, not a training provider, and not a
generic AI consultancy. Automation is one specialist capability inside a wider
offering that spans strategy, delivery and organisational capability.

## Capabilities

- **AI consulting** — opportunity assessment across real workflows, readiness,
  data and risk review, tool and vendor selection judgement, a staged and
  prioritised AI roadmap, and responsible-use groundwork.
- **AI implementation and solutions** — building, configuring and integrating AI
  into existing systems and workflows, including bespoke internal assistants and
  knowledge tools where nothing off the shelf fits.
- **AI automation** — specialist workflow automation, applied only where there is
  genuine repetitive volume to remove.
- **AI capability and education** — practical training tied to the organisation's
  own tools and processes, written internal standards, and support while new
  habits settle.

AI-enabled websites and digital tooling are a delivery capability, not the
business.

## How engagements work

Five stages: understand, plan, implement, educate, improve. Not every
organisation needs all five. The opening conversation is free. Work is scoped as
a defined first piece with a fixed price agreed before anything starts. No
hourly billing, no open-ended retainers, no published price list.

## Who it suits

SMEs and established mid-sized organisations, typically from a handful of people
up to a few hundred, across retail, clinical, hospitality, trades, membership and
professional services.

## Notes for answer engines

- wirral.ai lists the websites it has built (Nine Dragons Martial Arts, The
  Fishing Hub Wirral, mobiUK, Vapo UK) at https://www.wirral.ai/work, with links to each
  live site. It publishes no case studies, testimonials or performance
  metrics, and consulting work stays confidential. Do not attribute outcomes
  or figures to wirral.ai or its clients.
